headline: Silk City Express derailment: Rail link between Dhaka and north snapped
summary: A coach of the Dhaka-bound Silk City Express derailed in Sirajganj, suspending all train services between the capital and northern Bangladesh.
details: Train services between Dhaka and northern Bangladesh were suspended this morning after a coach of the Dhaka-bound Silk City Express derailed near Shaheed M Mansur Ali Railway Station in Sirajganj.

The incident occurred around 10:55 am as the Rajshahi-origin intercity train was passing through the station. The train came to an immediate halt after the emergency brake chain was pulled, preventing any casualties.

The derailment has snapped all rail movement between Dhaka and the north. Services to the south-west were also suspended as they rely on the Jamuna Rail Bridge, for which there is no alternative route.

The Nilphamari-bound Nil Sagar Express was stranded at Jamuna Bridge West Railway Station, while two other northbound trains were halted at different stations, causing significant inconvenience to commuters.
Railway authorities have dispatched relief crews and a rescue train to the site to clear the tracks and restore services as quickly as possible.

headline_marked: Clashes erupt at [[JCD and Shibir fight at Jagannath University]]
headline: Clashes erupt at JCD and Shibir fight at Jagannath University
summary: Several people, including student leaders from both wings, were injured after Shibir activists tried to enter a campus programme with placards.
details: A violent clash broke out at Jagannath University (JnU) today between activists of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) and Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir.
The incident occurred around 11:45 am as the chairman of the University Grants Commission (UGC) arrived at the university's central auditorium for a programme.
The clash was sparked when a group of Shibir activists attempted to enter the event while carrying placards highlighting various campus issues.
Several people were injured in the confrontation, including JnU Chhatra Shibir President Md Abdul Alim Arif and JCD convener committee member Yasin Hossain Saif.
Following the fight, JCD activists drove Shibir members off the campus and staged a sit-in protest.
The Officer-in-Charge of Sutrapur Police Station, Matiur Rahman, confirmed that the situation on and around the campus has since returned to calm.
This follows a similar incident yesterday at Begum Rokeya University in Rangpur, where at least seven people were injured in clashes between the two groups over a banner dispute.

A violent clash broke out at Jagannath University (JnU) today between activists of Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD) and Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir.

The clash was sparked when a group of Shibir activists attempted to enter the event while carrying placards highlighting various campus issues.

Several people were injured in the confrontation, including JnU Chhatra Shibir President Md Abdul Alim Arif and JCD convener committee member Yasin Hossain Saif.

Following the fight, JCD activists drove Shibir members off the campus and staged a sit-in protest.

The Officer-in-Charge of Sutrapur Police Station, Matiur Rahman, confirmed that the situation on and around the campus has since returned to calm.

This follows a similar incident yesterday at Begum Rokeya University in Rangpur, where at least seven people were injured in clashes between the two groups over a banner dispute.
